component.name: Hew
component.summary: 3D modeling the SketchUp way, on watertight solids

description.p: Hew is a 3D modeler: draw on faces, push and pull them, and let inference snapping do the aiming. Every closed extrusion is a discrete, watertight object, and combining objects is always an explicit choice, so a model is printable from the first click.
Hew opens and saves SketchUp files of every version, from SketchUp 3 through 2027.
